pucchānusandhi.p: [ pucchā + anusandhi ] (pu) Google Translate Pissa Nuthande. (1) The question is - the connection that should be made - becoming the sermon. (2) The connection between the question and the problem. (3) The question related to the question. (4) The question is related to cause. (5) Relating the question to the answer. (6) Connecting the lower sermon with the upper sermon that is the subject of the problem.
